description: Realistic prospect reply samples covering every class in AI_COMMUNICATION_SYSTEM.md

classes.description: Explicit interest, ready for a call
samples: Yes I'd love to see this. When can we jump on 15 min this week?
Send me a Calendly link, this is exactly what I've been looking for
Interesting — call me at (415) 555-2109 tomorrow before 11am

classes.description: Curious, needs more info before committing
samples: How does this compare to Boulevard? We use them now
Can you send me pricing before we chat?
What kind of clinics have you done this for?
How long does setup take? We're slammed until September

classes.description: Interested but hitting a real blocker
samples: Our EHR is Aesthetic Record — does this even work with it?
We tried an agency before and they ghosted us after 2 months
$1000/month is a lot. What's your smallest package?
Isn't this a HIPAA violation? We can't have patient data in Google Sheets
Reach back out in 3 months, we're mid-move
Sounds cool but Q4 is not the right time
I'll bring this up with my partner and get back to you

classes.description: Not for them, but knows someone
samples: Not for me but my friend runs a clinic in Scottsdale — should I connect you?
We're too big for this. Try Dr. Kim at Verve Aesthetics

classes.description: Wants off the list — HARD STOP
samples: Take me off your list
Unsubscribe
Do not email me again
How did you get my email? Remove me
We're a chain of 40 locations, this is way too small
I'm a solo esthetician working from home, no bookings system
We only do medical (not aesthetic) — dermatology practice
This is spam and I'm reporting it
You should be ashamed of yourself for cold emailing medical practices
I'm forwarding this to my attorney

classes.description: OOO / autoresponders — do NOT count as engagement, do NOT respond
samples: I am out of the office until August 15th. For urgent matters contact...
Auto-response: Thank you for your message. I will reply within 2 business days.
